# sfcompute_workspaces (Data Source)

Reads workspaces from SF Compute (`GET /v2/workspaces`). All pages are fetched unless `limit`, `starting_after` or `ending_before` is set.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ending_before` (String) Cursor for backward pagination.
- `id` (List of String) Filter by workspace ID, resource path, or name (repeatable).
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of results to return (1-200, default 50).
- `starting_after` (String) Cursor for forward pagination (from a previous response's `cursor` field).

### Read-Only

- `cursor` (String) Pass as `starting_after` or `ending_before` to paginate.
- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `has_more` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a workspace resource. Format: sfc:workspace:<account>:<name>.
